mandatory_query_rules: PUBLIC SECTION != PROTECTED MIGRATION PAGE IDENTITY
PROTECTED BASELINE PAGE ID COUNT != FINAL PAGE COUNT
18 is the current producer reading-section count, not canonical page_count.
52 is the protected internal migration identity count, not public or final page_count.
112 is a historical v1.11 snapshot, not the current complete Web carrier count.
Never answer 18, 20, 52, 111 or 112 as the current final project page count.
When asked current public Web structure, answer 18-section direct design-work reading + bottom-right supplement unless superseded by newer explicit Current authority.
When asked current Web page/surface count, answer current_complete_integrated_web_surface_count.status first; do not substitute 18 or the stale 112 snapshot.
When asked project page count, answer canonical_page_count.status first, then explain other counts by semantic role.
Newer file timestamp alone does not override this contract; only explicit newer Current Authority / PAGE REGISTER / Count Contract may supersede it.
